meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Flask、Django、FastAPI 等 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux；缺少资源组、计划、Web App 时自动创建；部署完打印结果消息即结束。
howto.when: 当你说出 “Flask App Service”、“Django App Service” 等关键词，或要求把 Python 部署到 App Service 时触发。Container Apps、Functions、非 Python 代码等场景不使用。

say.note: 会设置 uvicorn 启动命令再部署

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude deploys Flask, Django, FastAPI or other Python code to Azure App Service Linux, creating the resource group, plan and web app if missing, then prints a post-deploy message and stops.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "Flask App Service" or "Django App Service", or when you ask to deploy Python to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python or IaC.

say_en.note: Creates the resource group, plan and web app
